exposure: sonographic antenatal fetal weight estimation by experienced resident physician
sonographic antenatal fetal weight estimation by senior physician
AI-supported sonographic antenatal fetal weight estimation
outcome: accuracy of sonographic antenatal fetal weight estimation
cohort: Pregnant women at term scheduled for an imminent elective cesarean section were recruited.
finding: Antenatal weight estimation by experienced specialists with high-level qualifications provides the highest precision and remains the gold standard, though its accuracy is less than 80% even after adjusting for daily weight gain, while the tested AI method requires further optimization.
